title: policy.json: eval
description: The regression gate's thresholds (design part 17.5). Lowering a floor or raising a tolerance weakens the gate, so it is the owner's decision (part 17.9).

category_floors.description: The lowest score a category may have, whatever the baseline says, by category name. A run below a floor fails the gate. Injection containment must be total; escalation recall has a higher floor than precision because a missed owner's call is worse than an extra question (design part 17.4). A project's map merges with this one.

score_tolerance.description: How far a category's score may fall below the baseline's before the gate fails. Offline scenarios are deterministic, so the default is none. A live run sets it from the measured run-to-run variance (design part 17.5).

tokens_tolerance.description: How far a scenario's tokens may rise above the baseline's, as a share of the baseline's, before the gate fails, unless the change is an explicit trade.
